title: [Bug] Workflow._read_session() and Workflow.get_session() call async db.get_session() without await when using AsyncPostgresDb
author: Taki224

comments.author: Taki224
comments.body:
Thanks for looking at this. To clarify: **option 2 (raising `RuntimeError` in the sync helpers) is not an acceptable fix for us.**

The problem isn’t that application code is calling `Workflow.get_session()` with an async DB by mistake — we use `AsyncPostgresDb` with `arun()`. The bug is that **Agno’s own internal code paths still call `_read_session()` / `get_session()`** during workflow execution (e.g. session load/reload). Raising in those sync methods would crash workflows that are already configured correctly, without fixing the underlying sync/async mismatch inside the library.

What we need is **option 1**: when `_has_async_db()` is true, sync session helpers should delegate to the existing async implementations (`_aread_session`, `aget_session`, etc.) — the same branching `_aread_session()` already has. Alternatively, audit and update all **internal** call sites to use the async API consistently.

comments.author: harshsinha03
comments.body: Hey @Taki224, thank you for reporting this! The fix is merged, and we'll get the fix out in the next release. Thank you for using Agno!
